verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own marketing documents a hosted feedback portal with public voting and a public roadmap, so the public-facing portal exists. Nothing in the pack shows that a PM can configure it without engineering help. The 'few clicks' claim refers to integrations, and the custom-domain and branding claims refer to changelogs, so neither transfers to the portal. Missing for 10: documented no-code portal setup or onboarding flow, portal branding and custom-domain configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can set up a public-facing feedback portal without engineering help

citations.quote: Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations.
Let users vote on each other's ideas & show a public roadmap.
